text:
Alex Chen: heads up — i'm about to jump off the bridge at 14:30 PT, paging still active for 50x spike on /v1/generate. can someone pick up driver and comms?
Maya Patel: ok i can take comms for the next 30m while you hand off. @Samir you good to drive?
Samir Rao: i can drive but i'm in the middle of a deploy. give me 5m to finish, then i'll take primary.
OpsBot: Incident #INC-2026-472 triggered: 10:28PT — 50x 500 errors on /v1/generate across prod-west. Affected customers: 3 large tenants. PagerDuty alert sent.
Alex Chen: baseline: spikes started ~10:25PT, error rate peaked at 10:28PT, error logs show `kv cache miss` floods and timeouts to storage-backend. runbook ref: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-failure
Jordan Lee: i’m on standby in case the storage team needs a hand. Is there a mitigation we can do quickly?
Maya Patel: i'll own external comms and customer status. i'll post on status page and DM account teams. alex — add me to the incident comm list.
Alex Chen: @Maya i've added you. message i'll send to status: "We are investigating elevated 500 errors for text generation in prod-west; partial mitigation underway; ETA updates in 15m."
Samir Rao: i'm ready to take driver now. what's current throttle / fallback state?
Alex Chen: we've increased retries and spun up an emergency autoscale group for the model pool, but KV-store latency is still the bottleneck. I've put a temporary circuit-breaker on long requests via `request_timeout=6s` in the gateway config.
Samir Rao: taking driver — i'll start by rolling back the recent model cache change (PR #2437) and re-evaluate cache warmup. will run `scripts/rollback_cache_change.sh` now.
Maya Patel: comms update: customers A,B,C notified via email + status page. added note about "investigating" and asked for any impact details. will post next update at +15m. :clock1:
Jordan Lee: small coverage gap note — APAC morning shift overlap is only 10m right now; if escalation goes past 11:00 JST we'll need a hand from the APAC oncall. tagging ops-schedule.
Alex Chen: good call. @Jordan please ping APAC oncall if this lasts >30m. i'm handing over bridge driver to Samir and comms to Maya. I'm going offline for the handoff now (oncall transfer).
Samir Rao: confirmed driver. steps i'm taking: 1) run rollback; 2) monitor error rate and tail `gateway.log` for 500s; 3) if errors persist, open a P1 to storage team and prepare fallback to smaller model variant.
Maya Patel: confirmed comms. i'll keep external messages and runbook link in the incident thread. quick note: using templated status — "Investigating — mitigation in progress. Next update in 15 minutes."
OpsBot: User-defined runbook note attached: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-failure — play #2 (rollback cache change) in progress.
Samir Rao: rollback applied, services restarting. monitoring.
Maya Patel: sent status update at 14:45 PT to customers and ops channels. added mention that account teams can DM me for details.
Alex Chen: thanks team — I'm now off the bridge. Samir you're primary driver, Maya comms owner. Jordan keep APAC loop if we exceed overlap window. i'll be reachable by DM for 15m. :thumbsup:
Samir Rao: acknowledged, will escalate to storage if error rate doesn't drop by 10% in next 10m.
Jordan Lee: copied. standing by to contact APAC if needed.
Maya Patel: logging next update 14:58 PT.
OpsBot: Incident metrics: error-rate dropping by 20% since rollback. Monitoring for stabilization.
Samir Rao: seems like rollback helped, continuing to watch for 1hr before full close. will create follow-up postmortem action items if needed.
Maya Patel: prepping customer summary draft for the account teams. will share in ~30m.
Alex Chen: great handoff — closing my side. thanks all. :heart:
